verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a payments platform could plausibly push order or payment events to developers. However, the pack documents no registrable outbound webhooks or event subscriptions for order created, updated, fulfilled or canceled events. The closest item is a vague claim to "confirm payment outcomes and trigger post-purchase actions in real-time." That describes payment-outcome confirmation, not a programmatic order-lifecycle event push, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent or backend can subscribe to order lifecycle events — created, updated, fulfilled, canceled — pushed programmatically
